project_policy_resolution.rationale: The result depends on player input, an out-of-band minigame, or presentation-space interaction that is outside the headless Activity authority. The simulator must expose the legal outcomes and accept one explicit result command.

algorithm: Use the exact public enemy identity, authored difficulty level and combat rank.
Prefer exact public per-level values for each numeric field.
If a value is absent, select the nearest public anchor for the same mechanically distinct variant; otherwise select the same family and rank; otherwise the same rank.
Apply the canonical enemy level curve to the anchor in checked six-decimal fixed point and round only at the field boundary.
Record the anchor, source evidence, inputs, formula revision, confidence and resulting value on the production row.
Never inherit the anchor's skills, AI, phases, summons, weaknesses, resistances or toughness.
enemy_numeric_policy.rounding: checked fixed-point, six decimal places, nearest ties away from zero at the production field boundary
enemy_numeric_policy.completion_rule: A variant may become ApprovedNumericApproximation only after every approximated field has all required evidence and its exact mechanic/AI definition passes targeted production fixtures.

gap_classification.insufficient_mechanic_evidence_policy: Block the affected content partition and add an evidence record; do not guess behavior or relabel it as a numeric approximation.
